note: docs/55's sweep on a WIDER roster: the repositories the `account` rule in widen.ts selected that hold a matched section, pinned at the revision that probe recorded. Everything about a run is docs/55's -- same prompt, same 600s cap, same shipped gate in --dry-run, same fence -- so the two sweeps are comparable. What differs is the roster and the sample: `pairs()` takes one matched section per repository, round-robin in name order, the first `- [ ]` and the first `- [x]` in each. That rule was committed before the sweep ran.

calls.command: cat testdata/e2e/unsupported-concurrency/*.yml testdata/e2e/unsupported-concurrency/*.json 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls testdata/e2e/unsupported-concurrency; echo ---; ls testdata/docs/concurrency-parse; cat testdata/docs/concurrency-parse/*
grep -n "run_status\|RunStatus\|enum.*Status\|struct.*Run\b\|struct RunRecord\|struct RunState" src/store_protocol.mbt src/lib.mbt src/executor.mbt 2>/dev/null | head -80

wc -l src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt && grep -n "RunRecord\|RunState\|struct Run\|enum Run\|\"queued\"\|\"in_progress\"\|\"cancelled\"\|\"completed\"\|fn run_cancel\|\"cancel\"\|write_run_json\|save_run\|load_run\|list_runs\|fn cmd_run" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt | head -150
grep -n "^fn main\|fn cmd_run\|\"run\" =>\|fn run_workflow\|spawn\|background\|daemon" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt | head -40
ls testdata/e2e/ | grep -i concur; echo ---; find testdata/e2e/unsupported-concurrency -type f 2>/dev/null
grep -rln "e2e" src/*.mbt | head; grep -rn "unsupported-\|expect.*reject\|CLI error" src/*_test.mbt 2>/dev/null | grep -i "e2e\|unsupported" | head -30

grep -rln "unsupported" --include=*.mbt --include=*.sh --include=*.ts --include=Justfile --include=justfile . 2>/dev/null | grep -v testdata; echo ---; find . -iname "justfile" -o -iname "Justfile" | head; echo ---; grep -n "e2e" -r --include=Justfile --include=justfile . 2>/dev/null

for d in unsupported-concurrency unsupported-permissions unsupported-uses; do echo "== $d =="; ls testdata/e2e/$d; cat testdata/e2e/$d/*.txt testdata/e2e/$d/*.expected* testdata/e2e/$d/cmd 2>/dev/null; done
grep -n "fn interpolate\|fn expand_expr\|fn eval_string_expr\|fn substitute_expr\|fn render_template\|fn interpolate_expressions\|fn expand_template" src/*.mbt | head -30
grep -n "\${{" src/executor.mbt | wc -l; grep -n "fn.*expr\|fn.*context\|eval_expr\|evaluate_expr" src/executor.mbt | head -60
grep -n "^pub struct\|^struct\|^pub fn new_" src/lib.mbt | sed -n '1,150p'
cat src/moon.pkg | head -60; echo ---; grep -rn "getpid\|process_id\|\"PID\"\|current_pid\|os.Getpid" src/ 2>/dev/null
grep -rn "@xfs\." src/executor.mbt src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt | sed -E 's/^([^:]+:[0-9]+):.*(@xfs\.[a-zA-Z_]+)\(.*/\1 \2/' | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u
sed -n '1900,1912p' src/executor.mbt; echo ---; grep -n "fn now_ms\|current_time_ms\|epoch_ms\|@time\|sys_now" src/*.mbt | head -20
grep -rn "fn now_ms\|started_at_ms\s*[:=]\|fn.*_ms(" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt src/executor.mbt src/lib.mbt | grep -i "now\|epoch\|time" | head -20
grep -n "fn default_run_root\|fn default_artifact_root\|fn default_cache_root\|fn default_workspace_root" src/cmd/actrun/main.mbt
